Aristotle

ey he would repeat the song by Ben Jonson which begins:

 I was not wearier where I lay.

 His mind when wearied of its search for the essence of beauty amid the spectral words of
anchor.suffix: or Aquinas turned often for its pleasure to the dainty songs of the Elizabethans. His mind, in the vesture of a doubting monk, stood often in shadow under the windows of that age,
